reports.title: Qualcomm Announces Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: The semiconductor industry is experiencing a broad-based increase in input costs across wafer fabrication, assembly, test, advanced packaging, memory and other materials. As previously disclosed, we are taking actions to reflect the higher input costs in our product pricing. We anticipate the full benefit of these actions to be reflected in QCT gross margins in the second half of fiscal 2027.
The following table summarizes GAAP and Non-GAAP guidance based on the current outlook.

Revenues | $10.4B - $11.2B
QCT revenues2 | $9.0B - $9.6B
QTL revenues | $1.3B - $1.5B
GAAP diluted EPS | $1.03 - $1.23
Less diluted EPS attributable to QSI | $—
Less diluted EPS attributable to share-based compensation | ($0.99)
Less diluted EPS attributable to other items3 | ($0.13)
Non-GAAP diluted EPS | $2.15 - $2.35

(1) Our outlook does not include provisions for proposed tax law changes, future asset impairments or for pending legal matters, other than future legal amounts that are probable and estimable. Further, due to their nature, certain income and expense items, such as certain investments, derivative and foreign currency transaction gains or losses, cannot be accurately forecast. Accordingly, we only include such items in our financial outlook to the extent they are reasonably certain. Our outlook includes the impact of any pending business combinations to the extent they are expected to close in the upcoming quarter. Actual results may differ materially from the outlook.
(2) Guidance as of the first quarter of fiscal 2027 is inclusive of Data Center.
(3) Our guidance for diluted EPS attributable to other items for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 is primarily related to acquisition-related items.
